title: HELLO (TELOS)
author: irpina
description: The smallest mod for TELOS on the Digitone mk1: kept in the unit's TELOS store and linked at boot, not flashed. It adds HELLO to the Mod Menu (hold a track key); HELLO opens a tile that counts how often it was picked. A template: a TELOS mod has only .run and .bss and names no firmware address.
